solution: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__ In cyclic quadrilateral PQRS, opposite angles are supplementary. ∠PQR + ∠PSR = 180° ⇒ ∠PQR = 180° − 100° = 80°. In ΔPQT, sum of angles is 180°. ∠T = 180° − (∠P + ∠PQR) = 180° − (70° + 80°) = 30°. **∴ The correct answer is 30°.**
